claims.native_result: cannot clearly rule out ASL-3 risks

citation.quote: To be clear, we have not yet determined whether Claude Opus 4 has deﬁnitively passed the capabilities threshold that requires ASL-3 protections. Rather, we cannot clearly rule out ASL-3 risks for Claude Opus 4 (although we have ruled out that it needs the ASL-4 Standard). Thus, we are deploying Claude Opus 4 with ASL-3 measures as a precautionary, provisional action, while maintaining Claude Sonnet 4 at the ASL-2 Standard.

For Claude Opus 4, our evaluations showed that, whereas we could conﬁdently rule out ASL-4 capabilities, we could not conclusively rule out ASL-3 capabilities—which led to our precautionary decision to deploy it with ASL-3 protections.

claims.native_result: remained below the ASL-3 thresholds of concern

citation.quote: In contrast, Claude Sonnet 4 showed more modest improvements that—while noteworthy—remained below the ASL-3 thresholds of concern.
